description.p: Aux Command is a Linux-native remote operations workstation. It brings SSH, SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SSH tunnels, RDP, VNC, Mosh, Telnet, serial consoles and local shells together in one polished workspace without hiding the Linux tools you already trust.

ul.li: Real PTY terminals for local, SSH, Mosh, Telnet and serial sessions
Graphical SFTP with drag-and-drop, inline editing and a resumable transfer queue
Embedded VNC and embedded RDP tabs, with native-client fallback
Local, remote and dynamic SSH tunnels with live status
Keyword highlighting for log triage and per-connection reachability
Encrypted credential vault, host-key verification and profile import/export

description.p: Terminal assist (OS detection, inline suggestions, autocorrect, dangerous-command guard), cross-session history search, multi-session command runner, session replay, live host stats, optional bring-your-own-endpoint AI assist, and a UI localized in nine languages.
Embedded RDP, SSH config Include parsing, multi-hop ProxyJump, log highlighting, connection health, and a redesigned interface.
